title: 第5章 英雄
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“吼——！”

无数的怪物犹如潮水般席卷而来。

它们的速度极快，灰白色的肢体在墙壁和地面上高速爬行，关节反弯，像一群被压扁的壁虎。

苏青青体力差，跑得上气不接下气。

姜瑶努力拉着苏青青。

两人的速度，远远比不上怪物。

很快，怪物群追了上来。

秦守猛地转过身。

他不能再跑了，他必须拦住怪物群，为姜瑶和苏青青争取时间。

“你们快跑，我拦住它们！”

他握紧拖把杆，横在身前，重心下沉。右腿后撤，膝盖微弯，杆身贴着小臂延伸出去。

【初级枪法精通】，发动！

冲在最前面的怪物四肢发力朝他弹射过来。

秦守没有躲。

他踏前一步，拧腰转胯。

手中的拖把柄，在空中划过满月般的弧线。

横扫千军！

拖把杆带着风声横扫出去，狠狠抽在怪物的脸上。

那颗缝合头被打得猛地偏向一侧，整只怪物被抽得横飞出去。

砰砰砰！

后面的怪物被砸倒了一大群。

怪物群的攻势为之一滞。

终于赢得了宝贵的时间。

苏青青被姜瑶拉着跑，回头看了一眼。

她看见的场景让她心脏几乎停跳——秦守背对着她们，横握着那根拖把杆，面对着如潮水般涌来的灰白色怪物。

秦守的背影在苏青青瞳孔里定格了。

这个男人，太男人了！

“秦守——！”

苏青青喊。

她的眼眶湿润了，心中缠绕着难言的情愫。

“别回头！”姜瑶拽紧她的手臂继续跑，“你回去只会拖累他！”

苏青青咬着下唇，眼泪像断了线的珍珠般滴落。

秦守听见了苏青青的呼喊，但他此时无暇顾及。

他低头看了看手中的拖把杆。

杆身破碎，布满裂纹。

这一件“临时兵器”已经到极限了，无法再支撑一波高强度的攻势。

秦守在心中叹息了一声。

如果有一杆真正的精铁长枪就好了。

“吼——！”

残虐的怒吼声再次响起。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Ho--!"

Countless monsters swept in like a tide.

Their speed is extremely fast, their gray-white limbs crawling on the walls and ground at high speed, their joints bent like a group of squashed geckos.

Su Qingqing's physical strength was poor and she was out of breath while running.

Jiang Yao tried her best to hold Su Qingqing.

The speed of the two was far inferior to that of the monster.

Soon, the monster group caught up.

Qin Shou turned around suddenly.

He can't run anymore, he must stop the monster group and buy time for Jiang Yao and Su Qingqing.

"Run quickly, I'll stop them!"

He gripped the mop handle tightly and held it horizontally in front of him, his center of gravity lowered.Step back with your right leg, bend your knee slightly, and extend the shaft of the club against your forearm.

[Basic Marksmanship Mastery], activate!

The monster at the front used all its limbs to launch itself towards him.

Qin Shou did not hide.

He took a step forward and twisted his waist and hips.

The mop handle in his hand drew an arc like a full moon in the air.

Sweeping thousands of armies!

The mop pole swept out with the sound of wind and slapped the monster hard on the face.

The sutured head was whipped to one side, and the entire monster was whipped out.

Bang bang bang!

A large group of monsters behind were knocked down.

The monster group's offensive stalled.

Finally gained valuable time.

Su Qingqing was pulled away by Jiang Yao and looked back.

The scene she saw almost stopped her heart - Qin Shou turned his back to them, holding the mop rod horizontally, facing the gray-white monsters coming like a tide.

Qin Shou's back was frozen in Su Qingqing's pupils.

This man is so manly!

"Qin Shou——!"

Su Qingqing shouted.

Her eyes were moist, and her heart was filled with unspeakable emotions.

"Don't look back!" Jiang Yao tightened her arm and continued running, "You will only drag him down if you go back!"

Su Qingqing bit her lower lip, tears dripping like broken pearls.

Qin Shou heard Su Qingqing's cry, but he had no time to care at the moment.

He looked down at the mop rod in his hand.

The shaft was broken and full of cracks.

This "temporary weapon" has reached its limit and can no longer support a wave of high-intensity offensive.

Qin Shou sighed in his heart.

It would be nice to have a real fine iron spear.

"Ho--!"

The brutal roar sounded again.
